item.title: Report – Milan Owner Gerry Cardinale Makes Real Madrid Starlet His Priority Ahead of Tresoldi
item.description: Report – Milan Owner Gerry Cardinale Makes Real Madrid Starlet His Priority Ahead of Tresoldi Milan appear to have settled on Endrick as their preferred attacking target for January, with Gerry Cardinale reportedly favouring the Real Madrid youngster over Nicolo Tresoldi. According to La Gazzetta dello Sport , the Rossoneri owner has personally accelerated the pursuit of the Brazilian after publicly expressing his admiration for the 20-year-old. Cardinale left little doubt about his intentions when discussing the transfer market, describing Endrick as one of the most gifted youngsters in the world in his position, if not the most talented. The Brazilian has struggled for regular playing time at the Santiago Bernabeu, accumulating just 160 minutes between La Liga and the Champions League this season. However, Jose Mourinho remains reluctant to sanction Endrick’s departure, considering he has been an important part of his plans at Real Madrid. Endrick is also reportedly happy in the Spanish capital, meaning Milan could face considerable obstacles in their pursuit. Milan Chief Prefers Endrick to Tresoldi Although Nicolo Tresoldi remains on Milan’s shortlist, Cardinale considers Endrick a more attractive option because of his versatility. The Real Madrid forward can operate as a center-forward, a right-sided attacker or an attacking midfielder, making him a potentially valuable addition to Ruben Amorim’s tactical system. By contrast, Tresoldi offers a more traditional center-forward profile, potentially complicating his integration alongside Goncalo Ramos. The Club Brugge youngster has also attracted Bayern Munich’s attention, particularly following Harry Kane’s injury. Milan could nevertheless benefit from Cardinale’s strong relationship with Roc Nation, the agency representing Endrick. A loan move or a permanent transfer with a buy-back clause could emerge as possible solutions, although much will depend on Real Madrid’s willingness to negotiate.

item.title: FG orders probe into deadly Bayelsa boat accident
item.description: By Folarin Kehinde The Federal Government has ordered an immediate investigation into the boat accident that claimed several lives in Bayelsa State, warning that it would no longer tolerate avoidable safety violations on the nation’s waterways. The Minister of Marine and Blue Economy, Adegboyega Oyetola, gave the directive to the National Inland Waterways Authority (NIWA), asking it to investigate the immediate and remote causes of the accident and submit its findings to him. The mishap occurred on Friday, November 20, in Ukubie, near Oweikorogha Community, Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State. In a statement issued on Sunday by his Special Adviser, Dr Bolaji Akinola, Oyetola also directed NIWA to work with relevant government agencies and the Bayelsa State Government to ensure a transparent and comprehensive investigation. The minister described the loss of lives as worrisome and unacceptable, expressing concern over reports that passengers involved in the accident were not wearing life jackets. He also raised concerns over the alleged absence of a passenger manifest, stressing that proper documentation of passengers was a critical safety requirement that must be strictly enforced. “Safety lapses on our waterways are no longer acceptable. The Federal Government will not fold its arms and watch its citizens perish on the waterways. We must get to the root of this tragedy and ensure that those responsible for enforcing safety regulations do their jobs,” he said. Oyetola recalled that he visited Bayelsa State on May 2, 2025, where he distributed 3,500 life jackets to water transport users as part of efforts to improve safety on the waterways. He also renewed his call on state governments to gradually phase out wooden boats and replace them with safer and more durable fibreglass or fibre-reinforced plastic vessels, particularly for passenger transportation. The minister disclosed that he had contacted Bayelsa State Governor, Douye Diri, to commiserate with him, the state government and families of the victims. He sympathised with the bereaved families and prayed for the repose of the souls of those who died in the accident, while urging stakeholders to work together to prevent a recurrence. The post FG orders probe into deadly Bayelsa boat accident appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Steelers vs. Eagles: Week 11 game picks
item.description: (Photo by Kevin Sabitus/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Pittsburgh Steelers and Philadelphia Eagles will face off on Sunday at 1:00 EST. The Steelers are hoping to avoid losing consecutive games for the first time this season, while the Eagles are looking to end a seven-game losing streak. Who will come out on top? Our staff weighs in. Ryland Bickley: I’ve bet against history once this year, unwisely picking the Steelers to beat the Browns in Cleveland on Thursday Night Football in Week 4. And you know what? I haven’t learned my lesson. Yes, the Steelers haven’t won in Philadelphia since the ’60s, but this Eagles team is a mess. After floundering against Joe Burrow and the Bengals last week, the Steelers defense should be able to find its footing against Joe Milton and a struggling Philly O-line. On the other side of the ball, I’m not too confident in Aaron Rodgers and co. to get things going on the road, but getting Roman Wilson back certainly helps. I think Pittsburgh does just enough to rebound from last week and win an ugly game on the road. Steelers 20, Eagles 17 . Mike Nicastro: Mike Nicaatro: The Steelers haven’t won in Philadelphia since 1965, but they’ll enter their house of horrors against a much different Eagles team. The Eagles have a depleted offensive line, an underwhelming run game, and they are on their third quarterback in Joe Milton. Unfortunately for the Steelers, their offense also leaves much to be desired. Father time might have officially hit Aaron Rodgers at the worst time, and DK Metcalf can’t seem to catch a cold in the winter. However, the black and gold are getting healthier at wideout, as Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson appear to be on track to get a helmet. That will help mitigate the challenges, and in an absolute rock fight, the Steelers offense will make a few more plays than the Eagles. Steelers 16, Eagles 10 . Austin Bechtold : Lyndon B. Johnson was president, the Steelers played in Oakland at Pitt Stadium, and the Penguins weren’t even a team yet. These are all true events from the last time the Steelers beat the Eagles in Philadelphia in 1965. This game SHOULD be a different story. The Steelers need a significant bounce-back week after being embarrassed in primetime against the Cincinnati Bengals. They only had 40 yards of total offense at halftime and the defense couldn’t slow down a red hot Bengals offense. This is a turning point in the season and will go one of two ways: the Steelers dominate Philadelphia and attempt to show the Bengals game was a fluke, the Steelers and Eagles play a close game down to the end and whoever has the ball last will walk away with a victory. Joe Milton starts for the Eagles and the team hasn’t scored more than 21 points since Week 2 against the Titans. The Steelers get Roman Wilson back and should help the passing game, but losing Mason McCormick is likely a big loss up front. The Eagles are also getting healthier off their bye week. item.title: Buccaneers get good news on Baker Mayfield, Yaya Diaby for Week 11 vs. Lions
item.description: Buccaneers get good news on Baker Mayfield, Yaya Diaby for Week 11 vs. Lions originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are going to need all the help they can get facing off against the Detroit Lions in Week 11. But heading into Sunday's matchup, there was some concern about two players. Quarterback Baker Mayfield and outside linebacker Yaya Diaby were both listed as questionable after Friday's practice, and their statuses were up in the air for the Lions game. But when inactives were announced, neither player was listed. As Scott Smith of the Buccaneers shared Sunday morning, both Mayfield and Diaby are good to go for Week 11 vs. Detroit. Buccaneers get good news as Baker Mayfield, Yaya Diaby are active "QB Baker Mayfield and OLB Yaya Diaby, the two players listed as questionable on Friday's injury report, are active and good to go today in Detroit," Smith reported. The Buccaneers will have their starting quarterback healthy, despite Mayfield's injury. While he's a bit banged up and might not be at 100% in this one, Mayfield being able to play is some good news. Jalon Daniels would've made another start had he been ruled out, and while Daniels did show some potential earlier this year, Mayfield is still the QB1 for a reason. MORE : One play, two devastating injuries: How Aidan Hutchinson’s Drake Maye sack shakes up AFC, NFC playoff races Facing a Lions defense that's susceptible to the pass, they're going to need Mayfield to throw the ball a lot on Sunday, especially with how good the Lions' offense is. Fortunately, the Buccaneers will have Diaby good to go. He should help pressure Jared Goff and raise the floor of this defense. Antoine Winfield Jr., Ayden Garnes, DeMonte Capehart, Billy Schrauth, Trevor Keegan, and Easton Stick are all inactive for Week 11, while Diaby and Mayfield are good to go. Sitting one game behind the Carolina Panthers in the NFC South, this is a huge week for the Buccaneers, as they look to stay within striking distance of the division lead. item.title: Landry Shamet's contract proving to be massive bargain for Knicks
item.description: Landry Shamet's contract proving to be massive bargain for Knicks originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Knicks have been guided by their stars this season, with Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns picking up right where they left off, but one role player from last season's championship team has delivered on a nightly basis. Landry Shamet scored 20 points in the Knicks' last-second win over the Trail Blazers on Saturday night, producing his second 20-point game in the last four contests. In hindsight, the contract Shamet signed to return to the Knicks is looking like a bargain for New York — and it's no coincidence New York has started to look like the team it was last season with him rolling. Here's a closer look at Shamet's efforts this season. Landry Shamet proving to be Knicks bargain Shamet is making under $5.5 million this season and playing like a Sixth Man of the Year candidate, Saturday's start notwithstanding. The Knicks veteran is averaging 11.0 points per game, a career-high, and shooting 45.3 percent from 3-point range. Shamet is also shooting just under 50 percent from the field. Shamet has been essential to the Knicks' current four-game win streak, averaging 16.3 points per game and shooting 14-of-24 (58.3 percent) from 3-point range during the stretch. Highest individual plus/minus in the entire Eastern Conference this season: 1. Landry Shamet: +145 Highest individual plus/minus among all bench players in the NBA this season: 1. Landry Shamet: +145 — Tommy Beer (@TommyBeer) November 20, 2026 Not only do the Knicks have Shamet locked in on a cheap salary this season, but he is under control in New York all the way through 2030. Here are the details. STREAM : Watch Knicks games on MSG live with DAZN Landry Shamet contract details Shamet re-signed with the Knicks on a four-year, $24 million contract in the summer. His salary increases by year, but it only tops out at $6.59 million in 2029-30. The Knicks have five players making more than $20 million this season, but there is a major gap between those five and the rest of the group; Shamet's $5.5 million salary is next, followed by Jose Alvarado's $4.4 million salary and Miles McBride's $3.96 million salary. Shamet is doing his best to make that gap look less dramatic on the court than it does on paper, and he has played a major role in the Knicks' turnaround from 0-3 to 10-6. item.title: Jets fans are split on whether Geno Smith or Cade Klubnik should start at quarterback
item.description: New York Jets quarterback Cade Klubnik (10) looks to throw the ball during an NFL Sunday football game between New York Jets and Buffalo Bills at MetLife Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026, in East Rutherford, NJ. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co In Week 10, Cade Klubnik got his first NFL regular season action in relief of an injured Smith. Klubnik played most of the Jets’ second half loss to the Buffalo Bills. In Week 11, it appears Smith will regain his starting role. We asked fans in our SB Nation Reacts survey whether this is the right call. A narrow majority said Klubnik should start this game. That is about as close of a result as you can get. It should be noted, however, that we asked a similar question a week ago, and only 28 percent of Jets fans voted that Klubnik should start. It seems like merely seeing Klubnik on the field was enough to sway a large number of fans because his play against Buffalo certainly wasn’t spectacular. Overall Jets fan confidence is down after the loss to the Bills. Only 20 percent of voters say they are confident in the team’s direction down from 28 percent last week. I’m not sure much a win over the Chargers will improve confidence, but I could see the number falling into single digits with a loss along with the proportion of fans who want to see Klubnik rising quite a bit. item.title: Otti begins construction of new Umuahia traffic corridor
item.description: By Steve Oko Abia State Governor, Dr Alex Otti, has commenced construction of a new road linking Bende Road through the Umuahia Post Office Tower and railway crossing to First Bank/Akanu Ibiam Road, with completion targeted before Christmas. The project, being executed by the Umuahia Capital Development Authority (UCDA), is designed to provide an alternative traffic corridor, ease congestion around Government House and Isigate, and improve connectivity within the state capital. The General Manager of UCDA, Engr. Kingsley Agomoh, who conducted journalists round the project site, said the road would allow motorists coming from Bende and Ikot Ekpene roads to connect to Abia Line, Aguiyi Ironsi Boulevard, Abia Express Tower and Onuimo Road without passing through the Government House axis. He said the project would significantly reduce traffic pressure on major roads, stimulate economic activities and improve the aesthetics of Umuahia. ” If you are coming from Bende Road, you pass through the Post Office Tower, cross the railway station and connect to First Bank, Ridge Club and Abia Line without going through the Government House axis,” Agomoh said. He explained that the project was part of Otti’s broader urban renewal programme, adding that the governor had also directed the relocation of Umuahia Railway Station to the Nnennaya Oti Bus Terminal. According to him, the state government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Nigerian Railway Corporation to facilitate the construction of the access road across the railway corridor. Agomoh also disclosed that another road linking First Bank to the Keystone, Sterling and FCMB bank areas would be reopened and reconstructed to provide motorists, particularly those coming from the Federal Medical Centre, Umuahia, with a shorter alternative route. He said the road, which had been encroached upon by adjoining property owners, was being reclaimed to restore access and ease movement within the commercial district. Describing the railway-crossing road as a signature project of the Otti administration, Agomoh said the governor’s urban renewal drive was repositioning Umuahia for increased economic activities and orderly development. He urged Abians to support Otti and other Labour Party candidates in the 2027 elections, arguing that continuity would ensure the completion of ongoing infrastructure projects across the state. item.title: Chiefs-Cardinals Inactives: DT Peter Woods to miss third straight game
item.description: MIAMI GARDENS, FLORIDA - SEPTEMBER 27: Peter Woods #99 of the Kansas City Chiefs runs across the field during an NFL football game against the Miami Dolphins at Hard Rock Stadium on September 27, 2026 in Miami Gardens, Florida. (Photo by Perry Knotts/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Kansas City Chiefs have released their list of inactive players for Sunday’s game against the Arizona Cardinals . Our inactives for today's Week 11 matchup against the Cardinals ⬇️ pic.twitter.com/bfbdQLqqHB — Kansas City Chiefs (@Chiefs) November 22, 2026 Running back Kenneth Walker, tackle Jaylon Moore, guard Trey Smith defensive tackles Peter Woods and Omarr Norman-Lott and cornerback Melvin Smith will not dress. Rookie Garrett Nussmeir has been designated as the third quarterback and is eligible to enter the game should starter Patrick Mahomes and backup Justin Fields become unavailable. Walker (groin), Smith (concussion) and Moore (ankle) had already been ruled out on Friday’s final injury report . Woods (neck) and Norman-Lott (knee) had been deemed questionable , but the team will hold them out at least one more week. Norman-Lott is a listed inactive for the first time this season as the Chiefs added him to the active roster on Wednesday with his practice window to return from the Reserve/Physically-Unable-to-Perform list expiring. Norman-Lott has spent the first half of the season continuing to recover from an ACL tear suffered in 2025. Woods left Week 9’s contest against the Denver Broncos with a neck injury. The first round rookie will now miss his third straight game. With a short turnaround before Thursday’s road game against the Buffalo Bills , the Chiefs were expected to be conservative with injuries against the Cardinals. On Saturday, Kansas City elevated running back Nate Carter and center Pete Nygra from the practice squad. As elevated players, they will automatically be returned to the team’s practice squad after the game. Carter and Nygra are both active for the contest. The Cardinals have also released their list of inactives. Our inactives for today pic.twitter.com/cuBfErOGZo — Arizona Cardinals (@AZCardinals) November 22, 2026 Quarterback Carson Beck, cornerback Starling Thomas V, offensive linemen Kingsley Eguakun and John Gaines II, and former Chiefs practice squad defensive tackle Andrew Billings will not go for the Cardinals. Obviously, the biggest name on Arizona’s list is Beck. The team turned to the rookie quarterback after former Chiefs backup Gardner Minshew suffered a season ending elbow injury in Week 9. However, Beck was a midweek downgrade in practice with back spasms. Despite being ruled questionable to close the week, Arizona downgraded Beck to out on Saturday before leaving for Kansas City. 40-year-old journeyman backup Josh Johnson — who has been with the team less than two weeks — will start for the Cardinals. item.title: Buccaneers at Lions: Week 11 inactives
item.description: CHICAGO, ILLINOIS - NOVEMBER 8: Baker Mayfield #6 of the Tampa Bay Buccaneers looks on before the game against the Chicago Bears at Soldier Field on November 8, 2026 in Chicago, Illinois. (Photo by Todd Rosenberg/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Tampa Bay Buccaneers return from their bye week Sunday as they take on the Detroit Lions at Ford Field, with some encouraging news surrounding quarterback Baker Mayfield. According to NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo, Mayfield is expected to play despite dealing with a painful foot injury suffered during Tampa Bay’s Week 9 loss to the Chicago Bears. Mayfield, who was listed as questionable on Friday’s final injury report, has reportedly been dealing with plantar fasciitis and spent portions of the bye week in a walking boot. The veteran quarterback returned to practice Thursday and Friday on a limited basis after sitting out Wednesday’s session. While the news surrounding Mayfield is encouraging, Tampa Bay will be without safety Antoine Winfield Jr., who was ruled out Friday with an ankle injury after missing all three practices during the week. The Buccaneers elevated safety J.J. Roberts from the practice squad Saturday to provide additional depth in Winfield’s absence. Outside linebacker Yaya Diaby was also listed as questionable with a knee injury despite returning to full participation Friday but will suit up for the Bucs this afternoon. For Detroit, the Lions will be without center Cade Mays, who was placed on injured reserve Saturday with an ankle injury. The Lions also entered the weekend with several injury concerns in their secondary, including cornerbacks D.J. Reed, Ennis Rakestraw Jr. and Khalil Dorsey, who were all listed as questionable. Tampa Bay (3-6) will look to snap its losing streak against a Detroit team (7-2) that has won five consecutive games. The Buccaneers and Lions kick off at 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX.

item.title: Dallas Cowboys fan from New Mexico dies after 49ers game altercation
item.description: Arlington police are looking into the death of a lifelong Dallas Cowboys fan days following an alleged altercation around kickoff during the game against the San Francisco 49ers, USA Today reported. The family of Mario Narro contacted police on Tuesday, Nov. 17, about the incident. Narro died on Wednesday, Nov. 18. Narro, 36, had traveled from Albuquerque to attend the NFC rivalry game when an alleged alteration with a 49ers fan ended when Narro was pushed and fell down a flight of stairs, his family told CBS News Texas and the California Post , a branch of the New York Post. His family said he had a swollen abdomen and bruising and sat through the game, but wasn't feeling well. He was taken to a stadium medical team, who then transported him to a hospital. He had multiple surgeries and died on Wednesday, Nov. 18. An official cause of death is pending. Cowboys owner Jerry Jones spoke about the fan's death on Dallas radio station 105.3 The Fan on Friday, Nov. 20. Jones said there was no record of the incident but the organization was looking into it. Jones added that the Cowboys would cooperate with authorities for any surveillance footage or information the team could find. "Let me make the point of, we really do have quite eons above what it was 10, 15 years ago, we have quite a surveillance of what's going on in every aspect of our game," Jones said. "So it is really rare if we didn't know of any incident. We've got too many people out there. We have 6,000 workers on game day." Dallas Cowboys vs Titans amid home struggles at AT&T stadium The Dallas Cowboys seek to rebound when they take on the Tennessee Titans (1-8) at home at AT&T Stadium on Sunday, Nov. 22, in NFL Week 11. Cowboys (4-6) switched defensive play-call responsibilities this week, with senior assistant and longtime NFL coach Mike Pettine calling plays while defensive coordinator Christian Parker remains on staff. The Cowboys are 1-4 at AT&T Stadium this season with the only win coming against the Washington Commanders in the first home game on Sept. 20. Last week, the Cowboys' lost at home 46-40 to San Francisco, whose fans turned large sections of the Cowboys' stadium 49er red last week. What time do the Dallas Cowboys play today? The Dallas Cowboys play the Tennessee Titans at 11 a.m. MT/ noon CT on Sunday, Nov. 22, at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. The game will air on FOX. Who do the Dallas Cowboys play today? item.title: 📋 Betis squad for Bratislava: Pellegrini has almost everyone 🤔
item.description: 📋 Betis squad for Bratislava: Pellegrini has almost everyone 🤔 After drawing 1-1 with Sevilla in El Gran Derbi, Betis turn their attention to the UEFA Champions League as they travel to face Slovan Bratislava. The Green and Whites sit 11th in the table with nine points (from three wins and one defeat) and are seeking a victory in Slovakia to strengthen their chances of reaching the next round and move closer to the automatic round-of-16 qualification spots. At the other end of the table are Slovan Bratislava, bottom of the competition in 36th place with no points after four consecutive defeats, having scored once and conceded seventeen. However, the Slovak side have shown a different side to their game domestically, sitting second in the Super Liga, seven points behind the leaders, while Betis are also enjoying a solid LaLiga campaign, occupying fourth place with 27 points. For this European fixture, Manuel Pellegrini has named a 24-man squad with Antony's inclusion the headline news. The Brazilian winger, who caused concern in the derby when he went off with severe bruising to his lower back, trained as normal and headlines a travelling squad with few surprises, in which third-choice goalkeeper Manu González is the only academy player. As for the absentees, Dani Ceballos (muscle discomfort) and José Antonio Morante (hip) remain in Seville through injury, while Iker Losada has been left out for tactical reasons. item.title: Dwight Howard Regrets Rejecting Stephen Curry Trade In 2011 And Passing On Warriors In 2013
item.description: Mandatory Credit: Kelley L Cox-USA TODAY Sports Dwight Howard regrets missing two opportunities to play alongside Stephen Curry , revealing that he opposed the Orlando Magic’s interest in acquiring the guard in 2011 before choosing the Houston Rockets over the Golden State Warriors in 2013. Speaking with Casey Kiernan on The AM Hoops Show , Howard admitted that he failed to recognize what Curry would become. At the time, he preferred Curry’s more established backcourt partner, Monta Ellis . “But I had an opportunity to play with Steph too, and I’m tripping. At the time, I wanted to play with Monta Ellis.” “The Magic wanted to get Steph. The Magic wanted to get Steph, and I said no. I said no because I didn’t know Wardell Steph Curry was going to be one of the greatest shooters in the world. At the time, Monta was the one who was playing all the minutes. I regret it…” Howard’s recollection describes a potential acquisition discussed with Orlando’s front office. It does not establish that the Warriors had agreed to a completed trade or that Howard formally possessed veto authority. Nevertheless, he clearly believes his preference helped close off an intriguing possibility. The numbers explain why Ellis appealed to him. In 2010-11, Ellis averaged 24.1 points and 5.6 assists while playing 40.3 minutes per game. Curry averaged 18.6 points and 5.8 assists in 33.6 minutes, although his 44.2% three-point shooting already demonstrated exceptional potential. Ellis was the more prominent scorer; Curry was still developing into the player who would transform basketball. Howard eventually left Orlando for the Los Angeles Lakers in 2012. Following one season there, he considered Golden State during his 2013 free agency before deciding to join Houston. Looking back, the possibility of sharing the floor with Curry and Klay Thompson leaves him astonished. “Me and Steph Curry? And Klay Thompson? Oh my God, what was I thinking? No, but I think that would have been a crazy team. The pick and roll with me and Steph, the pick and roll, oh my God.” The Warriors’ pursuit was real, but bringing Howard aboard required financial maneuvering. Contemporary reporting described efforts to clear salary and potential sign-and-trade arrangements involving the Lakers. Keeping every important young player while adding Howard was not necessarily guaranteed. The Warriors ultimately acquired Andre Iguodala that summer. On the court, Howard’s excitement is understandable. His screening, lob finishing, rebounding, and rim protection could have complemented Curry’s shooting beautifully. Defenses would have faced a difficult choice between stepping toward Curry and allowing Howard space to finish above the rim. Still, adding a dominant center would have changed Golden State’s development, rotations, and eventual championship formula. Nobody can simply insert Howard into the Warriors’ future dynasty and assume every subsequent success remains intact. That uncertainty makes this a fascinati

item.title: ‘You criticise him too much’ – Pedri defends ‘exceptional’ Barcelona teammate after Villarreal
item.description: ‘You criticise him too much’ – Pedri defends ‘exceptional’ Barcelona teammate after Villarreal Barcelona star Pedri has on Sunday evening launched a stern defence of teammate and midfield partner Frenkie de Jong. This comes fresh off the Dutchman’s latest fine performance in Blaugrana colours. Barcelona kicked their campaign back into gear following the international break a short time ago, welcoming Villarreal to the Camp Nou for a La Liga clash. When all was said and done, the Catalans recovered from two goals down, to emerge on the right side of a 3-2 result. The aforementioned Frenkie de Jong was asked to fill an unfamiliar role for the afternoon, slotting into the heart of Barca’s backline. The former Ajax man, though, showcased his versatility and class over the course of the 90 minutes, playing a key role in his side’s eventual comeback. Speaking to the media following the full-time whistle, Pedri therefore made use of the opportunity to heap some well-earned praise on his long-time teammate: ”He’s an exceptional player, one of the best. He can play at full-back, centre-back or in midfield. With his qualities, he could probably even play in goal! He gives us so much, and I honestly think people criticise him too much. If you really watch what he does on the pitch, you’ll realise just how good he is.” Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Alia, Akume, Suswam, others meet over Benue APC crisis
item.description: By Peter Duru, Makurdi Governor Hyacinth Alia of Benue State has reiterated his commitment to reconciliation and unity within the All Progressives Congress (APC) following a meeting with prominent party stakeholders in Abuja. The meeting, held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, was convened by the North Central Presidential Reconciliation Committee, chaired by former Katsina State Governor, Senator Ibrahim Shema, as part of efforts to resolve disagreements among party leaders in Benue. Those in attendance included the Secretary to the Government of the Federation (SGF), Senator George Akume; former Benue State Governor, Senator Gabriel Suswam; Senator Barnabas Gemade; Senator Jack Gyado; and Elder Simon Shango. Alia disclosed the meeting in a post on his verified social media handle, saying the engagement lasted about two hours and provided an opportunity for the stakeholders to discuss the future of the party in the state. He said: “Today, (Saturday, November 21, 2026) I joined fellow Benue APC stakeholders in Abuja for a reconciliation meeting convened by the North Central Presidential Reconciliation Committee, chaired by Sen. Ibrahim Shehu Shema, former Governor of Katsina State. “The meeting, which lasted about two hours, brought together the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Sen. George Akume, former Benue State Governor, Sen. Gabriel Suswam, Sen. Barnabas Gemade, Sen. Jack Gyado and Elder Simon Shango. “I thank Sen. Shema and his committee for bringing us together. Reconciliation takes a willingness to listen, to speak frankly and to keep working together even where differences remain. “My commitment is clear. I will continue to engage with our leaders and stakeholders in the interest of a united APC, while keeping the peace, security and development of Benue State at the centre of my work. “The people of Benue entrusted us with the responsibility to serve, and that responsibility must continue to guide us.” The post Alia, Akume, Suswam, others meet over Benue APC crisis appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: BYU Opens as Double-Digit Favorite Over Cincinnati
item.description: Nov 22, 2025; Cincinnati, Ohio, USA; BYU Cougars running back LJ Martin (4) carries the ball against the Cincinnati Bearcats in the first half at Nippert Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Aaron Doster-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect BYU opened as an early 12.5-point favorite over Cincinnati for Saturday’s regular-season finale in Provo, according to FanDuel . The point total is 56.5 as of this publishing. The Cougs are coming off a game that was a lot more stressful than it needed to be. BYU beat Kansas 31-29 in triple overtime. It wasn’t pretty, but it moved BYU to 9-2 overall and 6-2 in the Big 12, and it kept the Cougs’ CFP and Big 12 title game hopes in play. Cincinnati comes to Provo at 6-5 and bowl eligible after beating Colorado 35-28 Saturday. The Bearcats are top 10 nationally in rushing offense behind 1,000-yard back Cole Tabb. The defense is one of the nation’s worst, however, allowing over 30 points per game. BYU needs a “get right” game on offense, and the Bearcats offer that. We’ll get more clarity on where BYU stands in the CFP race after Tuesday’s rankings, but the Big 12 title game is still on the table too. Utah has officially clinched its spot in Arlington, so BYU and Texas Tech are competing for the second spot. As long as the Red Raiders beat TCU, they’re into the Big 12 title game. BYU would get in with a win if Texas Tech loses to TCU, because the Cougars would hold the tiebreaker of record against common opponents. Tech and TCU play Thursday in a Thanksgiving game, so BYU will know exactly what’s at stake before kickoff Saturday. The title game is Friday, December 4, at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. BYU-Cincinnati play Saturday at 1:30 MT on FOX.

item.title: Chris Berman announces Tom Jackson’s death in emotional tribute on ‘Sunday NFL Countdown’
item.description: Chris Berman grew emotional Sunday while discussing Tom Jackson, his longtime ESPN broadcast partner, who died Friday at 75 . “He was a vital 75,” Berman said on ESPN’s “Sunday NFL Countdown” show. “Tom was poignant. He was active. This is a shock.” Berman, who said he spoke “at length” to Jackson as recently as Tuesday, also called the former Broncos linebacker “one of the best human beings ever to walk the planet.” He quoted The Temptations hit song “My Girl,” saying Jackson always “brought sunshine on a cloudy day.” Chris Berman remembers his longtime broadcast partner and dear friend, Tom Jackson, following his passing. pic.twitter.com/4pufldOXSV — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 22, 2026 ESPN commentators Tom Jackson and Chris Berman cover the game between the Chicago Bears and St. Louis Rams in St. Louis, Missouri, Dec. 11, 2006. Getty Images “All of us are stunned,” Berman read from a statement. “I’m stunned, we’re stunned and you’re stunned. We’ve lost one of the best human beings ever to walk the planet, Tom Jackson. I was fortunate to work side by side with Tom for 30 years, primarily on NFL Primetime and Sunday NFL Countdown. “It was a labor of love for our whole team, both in front of the camera and behind it. We always hoped our viewers enjoyed the shows as much as we did bringing it to them every week.” ESPN chairman Jimmy Pitaro added that Jackson — a three-time Pro Bowler over 14 NFL seasons with the Broncos — was “one of the most influential and beloved figures in ESPN’s history.” “He brought the credibility of an All-Pro NFL player, the insight of a gifted analyst and a warmth and authenticity that connected with generations of football fans,” Pitaro said. “Alongside Chris Berman, he helped make NFL Primetime an iconic part of our football weekends. In fact, ESPN’s NFL studio is named the Chris Berman-Tom Jackson Studio, a distinction unmatched in our history and a fitting tribute to their lasting impact. Sports anchors Chris Berman, left, and Tom Jackson speak during a ceremony honoring Berman with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in Hollywood, Calif. Getty Images “Away from the set, Tom was a trusted colleague, generous mentor and dear friend to many. We extend our deepest condolences to his family, friends, former teammates and all who loved him. His legacy at ESPN, throughout the NFL and among the countless fans who admired his incredible work will endure.” Jackson retired from ESPN in 2016 but returned for a digital edition of “NFL Primetime” alongside Berman in 2019. He had been awarded the Pete Rozelle Radio-Television award by the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2015, an honor which Berman also had earned in 2010. Jackson is survived by his wife, Jennifer, and two daughters, Taylor and Morgan.

item.title: Chiefs’ Eric Bieniemy Comment on Rising Rookie Emmett Johnson’s ‘Maturity Level’
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs are finding out how great of an asset rookie running back Emmette Johnson is. He gave them a pretty good idea about his potential during the team’s 35-13 takedown of the Atlanta Falcons on the road in Week 10. Starting in lieu of the absent Kenneth Walker III, the former Nebraska Cornhuskers star running back did it all for the Chiefs, as he rushed for 101 yards on 22 carries and recorded 70 receiving yards and two touchdowns on six receptions and seven targets. Chiefs Rookie RB Gets Honest Assessment From OC Sep 14, 2026; Kansas City, Missouri, USA; Kansas City Chiefs running back Emmett Johnson (10) kneels in the end zone against the Denver Broncos prior to the game at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Denny Medley-Imagn Images On Thursday, Kansas City offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy gave a candid take on Johnson. “I manage him a little different because he was a Cornhusker, so I gotta make sure, and we can build the right trust,” the 57-year-old Bieniemy said when asked about his approach to Johnson (via a video shared by Sports Radio 810 WHB on X). Bieniemy added: “You try and handle everybody the same, but on top of that, you certain guys. You can get after a little bit more, and other ones you may have to pull ’em over to the side. But Emmett is a very coachable kid, very coachable kid. He does not take anything for granted. You know, sometimes you forget he’s a rookie because of his maturity level. But I thought he did a great job of just stepping in and doing his part.” Here’s more of what Bieniemy said about the rookie tailback. #Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy describes what it's like to coach rookie RB Emmett Johnson. item.title: ‘Where is…?’ – Knicks fans shocked by who was missing from Homecoming event at Trail Blazers game
item.description: Photo by Caleb Bowlin/Getty Images The New York Knicks celebrated their annual Homecoming Game on Saturday night, welcoming more than 50 former players back to Madison Square Garden. However, one notable name was missing from the celebrations, as Charles Oakley was nowhere to be seen. The Knicks held a private dinner on Friday before recognising their former stars at half-time of their clash with the Portland Trail Blazers. Walt ‘Clyde’ Frazier, Bernard King and Earl Monroe were among those in attendance, but Oakley’s absence did not go unnoticed. Fans immediately questioned why the former Knicks forward was not included. One wrote: “We want Charles Oakley.” Another asked: “They still not letting Charles Oakley in the building?” A third posted: “Where is Charles Oakley?” Oakley has not returned to Madison Square Garden since his ejection during a Knicks game against the Los Angeles Clippers in February 2017. An alleged verbal confrontation with owner James Dolan escalated into a physical scuffle with arena security. The incident culminated a long-running feud between the pair, with Oakley having repeatedly criticised Dolan’s running of the franchise. Although the former Knicks star is not currently under an active ban from the arena, he has not returned since that night. His absence was particularly frustrating for some Knicks supporters, with one tweeting: “Problem here is there’s no Charles Oakley or Patrick Ewing – two of the biggest names in Knicks history.” Another added: “If that DISGRACE Dolan won’t let this man’s name be said, we’re damn well gonna recognize it here… CHARLES OAKLEY! WE appreciate you.” The Knicks did eventually give their fans something to celebrate, as Mikal Bridges hit a buzzer-beating three-pointer to secure a dramatic 97-96 win over Portland. However, Oakley’s absence remained a talking point on a night dedicated to the franchise’s history. It’s fun, but on the other side we need to be ready for anything.” Mike Maignan shook off a knock on international duty to start in goal, but Strahinja Pavlovic is still not at 100 per cent, with Matteo Gabbia, Samuel Chukwueze, Fikayo Tomori, Ruben Loftus-Cheek and Alexis Saelemaekers still injured. item.title: Maui Invitation Preview: Clemson vs. Ole Miss
item.description: LAHAINA, HAWAII - NOVEMBER 26: The Southwest Maui Invitational logo is shown on the floor before the championship of the Southwest Maui Invitational between the Southern California Trojans and the Arizona State Sun Devils at the Lahaina Center on November 26, 2025 in Lahaina, Hawaii. (Photo by Mitchell Layton/Getty Images) | Getty Images Dates: Monday, November 23 – Wednesday, November 25 Location: Lahalna Civic Center, Hawaii The Clemson Tigers will have ample opportunity to earn a non-conference resume win when they head to Hawaii to compete in the Maui Invitational. 2026 Southwest Maui Invitational begins on Monday, November 23rd as Clemson and Ole Miss face off in game 1. The winner of game 1 will face the winner of BYU (KenPom No. 24) vs. Washington (No. 87) and the losers will matchup in the consolation bracket. On the other half of the bracket, Arizona (No. 8) — who just beat UConn — will be heavy favorite against Colorado State (No. 102) and then whoever they play between VCU (No. 57) and Providence (No. 50). Clemson will play one of the teams from this side of the bracket in their third and final game of the tournament which hopefully is the tournament championship. For now, we focus on the task at hand, Ole Miss. Opponent: Ole Miss (4-0) Game Time: 2:30pm Eastern – Monday, November 23 TV: ESPN2 Coach Chris Beard enters his fourth season at Ole Miss following five seasons at Texas Tech and one at Texas. You may remember he led the Red Raiders to a National Championship game appearance where they lost to Virginia in overtime. He parlayed his success at TTU to the Texas Longhorns job where they reached the Round of 32. He was fired from his alma mater for cause due to a domestic violence accusation that was later shown to false. The lie forced him out of the job to a less ideal location — Ole Miss. As a result, the Rebels find themselves with a top tier basketball coach despite their sordid history that includes a 7-10 record in the NCAA tournament (compare to Clemson at 14-15). In his three seasons, Coach Beard has brought the Rebels to the tournament once. They were a 6-seed in 2025 and advanced to the Sweet 16 with wins over UNC and Iowa State. Last year wasn’t as ideal though. They finished just 15-20 despite a hot finish in the SEC tournament. The lost 10-straight games in SEC play at one point and were an awful shooting team. They ranked just 221st in 3P% and 217th in 2P%. Of course, team turnover is so heavy, scouting last year’s squad only hints at what this team is. Patton Pinkins was a freshman at Ole Miss last year and returns to the Rebels as their best shooter. He had 42.2 3P% on 102 attempts. So far he has been their only major threat from deep going 9-12 so far this season. The rest of the team is a combined 18/70 (.257) from 3. That’s bad and it is critical for a Clemson team that has defended the 3 very poorly this season. The Tigers are allowing a .380 3P% which ranks 217th nationally. item.title: DeVonta Smith is Not Ready to Surrender Amid Eagles’ Brutal 2026 Season
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles are technically still in the race for a spot in the NFL playoffs, but it’s fair to dismiss their chances of playing beyond the regular season. At 2-7 through 10 weeks , Philadelphia is at the bottom of the NFC East Division standings, where the 5-3-1 New York Giants are leading the rest of the group. Still, there is hope for Philadelphia, and wide receiver DeVonta Smith, and that’s all he needs to keep believing in his team. “At the end of the day, you know, it’s not over, especially in this division,” the former Alabama Crimson Tide star wide receiver said, via Ed Kracz of Sports Illustrated . “I feel like there’s still a chance in our division right now. But you can only take it one week at a time, so focusing on this week. Getting the win would be the biggest thing right now; just get back on track.” Eagles’ Smith on Track to Play in Week 11 Nov 28, 2025; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA; Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith (6) looks on during warmups prior to the game against the Chicago Bears at Lincoln Financial Field. Mandatory Credit: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Injuries have played a major part in Philadelphia’s struggles. Quarterback Jalen Hurts is done for the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs. As for Smith, he’s missed five games already because of a nagging hamstring issue. He missed Weeks 4 and 5 before returning to action in Week 6. However, he sat out the next three games. The good news for the Eagles is that Smith appears to be on track to play in this coming Sunday’s Week 11 game in Philadelphia against the Pittsburgh Steelers. He logged in a full practice on Thursday, a good sign for his availability versus Aaron Rodgers and company. Philly’s offense could certainly use a boost, and Smith can provide that to the team, even if Hurts isn’t playing quarterback for the Eagles at the moment. On the season, the 28-year-old Smith has 310 receiving yards and two touchdowns on 26 receptions. item.title: I didn’t politicise it — Gov Yusuf narrates how wife left Kano Govt House
item.description: Kano State Governor, Abba Yusuf, has broken his silence on his marital crisis with wife, Zainab, recounting how she allegedly left the Government House and later initiated divorce proceedings against him in Abuja. The governor, in an interview with BBC Hausa aired on Sunday, said he had remained quiet despite developments in the marriage, which he said had lasted about two decades and produced children. Yusuf said Zainab, a niece of his former political ally, Rabiu Kwankwaso, was previously married before they got together. He recalled that their relationship eventually deteriorated, leading to her departure from the Government House, an experience he said he endured without publicly discussing the matter. “Many things happened, to the point where her belongings were packed and she was taken away from my house, and through it all, I remained patient and did not speak out,” Yusuf said. He said he had tried to reassure their children that their mother would return, but was subsequently taken aback when the matter ended up in court. The governor said he was particularly surprised that the divorce suit was filed in Abuja rather than Kano. “Suddenly, she dragged me to court, a court in Abuja, not even in Kano,” he said. Yusuf described the development as distressing, adding that he had information about the circumstances surrounding his wife’s departure but would not publicly disclose the details. Asked whether he was using the family dispute for political purposes, the governor denied bringing politics into the matter, questioning how anyone in a similar situation would react. “I am not the one who politicised it. If this was done to you, how would you feel?” he asked. He further lamented that his wife’s belongings were removed and she was taken to another residence without his knowledge, before he learnt that she had instituted legal proceedings against him. The marital dispute is before the Upper Area Court in the Gudu District of Abuja, where the divorce case, marked CV/97/26, was adjourned until December 15. The adjournment followed a request by Kano Commissioner for Information, Sanusi Bature, who represented Yusuf, for more time to brief the governor on the court proceedings. The crisis has drawn political attention because of Yusuf’s relationship with Kwankwaso, who played a significant role in his political rise. Their relationship reportedly deteriorated after Yusuf defected from the New Nigeria Peoples Party to the All Progressives Congress in January 2026, while Kwankwaso later joined the New Nigeria Democratic Congress. The post I didn’t politicise it — Gov Yusuf narrates how wife left Kano Govt House appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Photos: Gunmen set Plateau secondary school ablaze in Bokkos
item.description: By Golok Nanmwa JOS – Suspected gunmen have reportedly set fire to Government Secondary School, Masharkut, in Butura District of Bokkos Local Government Area of Plateau State. The incident, which occurred on Sunday afternoon, triggered panic in the community after residents noticed smoke billowing from the school premises shortly after church service. A community member, Daniel Bwehfa Makodeng, who reported the incident to journalists, said the school was set ablaze at about 1pm. “Suspected bandits set the school on fire around 1pm,” he said. He explained that residents initially noticed smoke coming from the school before discovering about 30 minutes later that the building was on fire. The Chairman of Bokkos Local Government Area, Hon. Amalau Amalau, also confirmed the incident, saying the council had received reports that the school was engulfed in flames. Speaking in a telephone interview, Amalau said the circumstances surrounding the fire and the identities of those responsible had yet to be established. “We only saw the school in flames. We cannot ascertain at the moment who was responsible or whether it was carried out by terrorists,” he said. The chairman confirmed that the incident occurred on Sunday, adding that the immediate concern was the destruction of the school building. Efforts to reach security operatives for confirmation and comments were unsuccessful as of the time of filing this report. The post Photos: Gunmen set Plateau secondary school ablaze in Bokkos appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Barcelona fight back from two goals down to beat Villarreal, extend La Liga lead
item.description: Spanish champions Barcelona came back from two goals behind to beat Villarreal 3-2 on Sunday and restore their three point lead at the top of La Liga. Barca edged clear of Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid, who had pulled level with them on Saturday after beating Celta Vigo. Two goals inside seven minutes from Tajon Buchanan and Tani Oluwaseyi gave Villarreal a commanding lead at Camp Nou and Barca winger Lamine Yamal missed a first half penalty. However the Catalan giants struck three times in an 11-minute spell in the second half to claim victory. Gerard Martin and Fermin Lopez pulled Barca level before Pau Navarro’s own goal gave them the three points. Barca have now won four consecutive matches across all competitions since their Clasico defeat by Real Madrid in October. “We suffered because we started the game badly, we let in two goals very early. I’ll remember how the team reacted but we have to work to ensure this doesn’t happen again,” Barca midfielder Pedri told DAZN. “Against a team like this you can’t always turn things around from two down.” The hosts were caught snoozing in the early afternoon sunlight and Buchanan fired Villarreal ahead in the fifth minute. Fermin Lopez gave the ball away with a careless pass and Canada international Buchanan produced a perfect sliced effort from distance to send the visitors ahead. Two minutes later Villarreal doubled their advantage when Tani Oluwaseyi, another Canadian, broke in down the left flank and smashed an effort over Joan Garcia into the roof of the net. Hansi Flick’s side should have pulled one back when Oluwaseyi felled Yamal in the area and a penalty was given after a VAR review. Yamal took it himself but dragged his effort against the post and wide. The winger tried to make amends with a burst inside from the wing before half-time but Peter Gulacsi palmed away his cross-shot and the goalkeeper and his defence combined to thwart Eric Garcia on the follow up. – Quickfire treble – Barcelona came out invigorated in the second half and quickly dragged themselves back into the match. Pedri shot wide and Gulacsi saved from Lopez’s low effort before Martin found the net in the 57th minute. Pedri crossed the ball in from the left for the defender to head home. Four minutes later Lopez slammed home the second after being teed up by Yamal, and the third was quick to follow. A clever backheel pass by Yamal fed Eric Garcia, whose cross was bundled into the back of his own net by Navarro. Substitute Anthony Gordon was denied by Gulacsi and then appealed for a penalty after a bump from Santi Comesana but went down too easily. Navarro was sent off for a second yellow card in stoppage time as Villarreal, ninth, left frustrated. “The (first Barca) goal psychologically killed us, they gained confidence, a couple of minutes later they equalised and from there it’s a lot more difficult,” Comesana told DAZN. Later Sunday Atletico Madrid, third, visit Getafe among other fixtures. Vanguard News The post Barcelona

item.title: Katsina ADC Gov Candidate Kaita Launches 2027 Campaign
item.description: The governorship candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Katsina State, Senator Ahmed Kaita, has officially launched his 2027 campaign in the Funtua senatorial zone, drawing a crowd of supporters as residents of Funtua Local Government pledged to back ADC candidates in all elective positions during the forthcoming general elections. The campaign rally, held on Sunday at Aya Primary School in Funtua, attracted scores of supporters from across Funtua and neighbouring communities, signalling the party’s determination to mount a strong challenge in the state. Addressing the crowd, Senator Kaita expressed gratitude for what he described as the overwhelming voluntary turnout of supporters, insisting that those in attendance were driven by a genuine desire for change and good governance rather than political inducement. The event attracted scores of supporters from across Funtua and neighbouring communities. He said the campaign would unveil its comprehensive policy agenda during the next rally scheduled for Faskari Local Government Area on Tuesday, explaining that the decision was deliberate to distinguish the ADC’s approach from that of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). “Today marks the beginning of the change that Katsina people have been yearning for. Everyone you see here came willingly because they desire good governance. I sincerely appreciate our supporters for the warm reception. By the grace of God, we will unveil our agenda in Faskari on Tuesday. We want to show the difference between our campaign and that of the APC-led government,” Kaita declared. Before proceeding to the rally venue, the ADC governorship candidate paid a courtesy visit to the Sarkin Maskan Katsina and District Head of Funtua, where he sought royal blessings, prayers, guidance and support ahead of the elections. The event also featured the ADC senatorial candidate for Funtua zone, Hon. Jamilu Muhammad Lion, whose appearance drew loud cheers from the large gathering of party faithful. The Funtua rally marks the first major campaign outing by Senator Kaita in the 2027 election season and sets the stage for the ADC’s statewide mobilisation as political activities gather momentum across Katsina State. item.title: Bayern’s Musiala suffered another seizure this week
item.description: Bayern Munich and Germany midfielder Jamal Musiala suffered another previously undisclosed seizure this week, according to information received by AFP subsidiary SID on Sunday. The incident, which is categorised by a brief and temporary loss of consciousness or awareness, occurred at training on Monday. Musiala collapsed twice on the pitch in pre-season with the 23-year-old later revealing he had a “neurological disorder” which can lead to “temporary but treatable seizures”. Monday’s incident was the second since Musiala’s announcement, with the player reportedly adjusting his medication to properly treat the condition while continuing to play. News of the incident comes as Bayern have faced criticism from footballers’ union FIFPRO for a “coordinated campaign” to pressure the Germany international to renegotiate his 2025-extended contract. “Bayern has a duty of care to Musiala. Any concerns about his contract should be raised privately with him and his representatives,” FIFPRO said in a statement. On Friday, Bayern supervisory board member and former CEO Karl-Heinz Rummenigge suggested the midfielder may need to take a pay cut if he cannot recapture his old form. “Based on what we know, it unfortunately suggests that it will be difficult for him to return to the level he so often demonstrated here in this stadium,” Rummenigge said. “If he doesn’t return to being the Jamal of old, then we need to have a conversation with his family, with the player, and, above all, with his agency — because, frankly, the current financial figures would no longer be justifiable.” The post Bayern’s Musiala suffered another seizure this week appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Taraba Yoruba community endorses Tinubu, Kefas for second term
item.description: By Femi Bolaji JALINGO – The Yoruba Community Council (YCC) in Taraba State has endorsed President Bola Tinubu and Governor Agbu Kefas for a second term in office, expressing confidence in their leadership and commitment to peace, security and development. The President of the council, Mr Joseph Abiodun Durojaye, announced the endorsement at the 2026 Yoruba Day celebration held over the weekend in Jalingo. The event brought together Yoruba residents from Oyo, Osun, Lagos, Ondo, Kwara, Ogun, Kogi and Ekiti states, among others. Durojaye expressed appreciation to the Kefas administration for its support and goodwill towards the Yoruba community, particularly the appointment of one of its members as a Special Adviser and financial assistance towards the construction of the Yoruba Community Council building. He appealed for continued government support to ensure the completion of the project, saying the building would serve as a permanent centre for community meetings, cultural activities, youth development and other programmes. The community leader formally declared the council’s support for Kefas’s re-election bid, subject to the democratic process and the decision of the electorate. He also expressed support for Tinubu’s re-election for another four-year term. According to him, the community believes in democracy, continuity, peace, security and development, urging both administrations to sustain programmes that improve the lives of Nigerians and promote inclusive governance. Durojaye reaffirmed the Yoruba community’s commitment to peaceful coexistence and cooperation with other ethnic groups in Taraba, describing the state as home to diverse communities. He said the community rejected violence, discrimination, hate speech and other actions capable of undermining unity, insisting that dialogue and mutual understanding remained the best ways to resolve disagreements. In his remarks, Senator Haruna Manu, representing Taraba Central Senatorial District, commended the community for its contributions to the socio-economic development of the state, particularly in commerce, education, agriculture and professional services. Manu, who was represented by Professor Yushau Ahmed Bali, described Taraba as a home for all and urged the Yoruba community to sustain cordial relations with other ethnic groups while promoting peace, unity and peaceful coexistence. He also expressed support for the community’s endorsement of Tinubu and Kefas for another term, urging residents to embrace mutual respect and democratic participation. Similarly, Senator Shuaibu Lau, representing Taraba North Senatorial District, commended the Yoruba community for its political support, describing the endorsement as a demonstration of confidence in the leadership of the President and the governor. item.title: Tinubu commits ₦450bn to agriculture, targets 500,000 farmers
item.description: President Bola Tinubu’s administration has committed ₦450 billion to agricultural financing programmes aimed at strengthening food security, boosting domestic food production and improving the productivity of smallholder farmers across the country. The administration has also approved the recapitalisation of the Bank of Agriculture (BOA) with ₦1.5 trillion to expand access to agricultural financing and support the cultivation of 500,000 hectares of farmland under the Renewed Hope Agenda. The All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council disclosed this in a statement issued on Sunday by its spokesperson, Dele Alake. According to the statement, the interventions have so far reached more than 500,000 smallholder farmers across 16 states, including over 70,000 women, through the Bank of Agriculture. It said the Federal Government was also addressing other challenges in the agricultural value chain, including access to quality seeds, fertiliser, mechanisation, irrigation, storage facilities and commodity markets. The statement explained that the Renewed Hope Smallholder Support and Value Chain Fund, with a programme value of ₦250 billion, was financing farmers through Farmer Aggregation Companies responsible for farmer registration, input distribution, extension services and market linkages. It added that the programme had facilitated the distribution of approximately 2.5 million bags of fertiliser and 300,000 bags of certified seeds. The initiative, according to the council, is targeting two million farmers and the distribution of more than 10 million bags of fertiliser. It noted that Northern Nigeria remained a major focus of the interventions because of the region’s dependence on agriculture as a source of livelihood and economic activity. States benefiting from the programme include Kaduna, Kano, Katsina, Niger, Borno, Gombe, Taraba, Adamawa, Yobe and Bauchi. To protect farmers against market uncertainties and distress sales, the Bank of Agriculture is also implementing a ₦200 billion Guaranteed Minimum Price Programme. Under the initiative, the bank has procured approximately 170,000 metric tonnes of maize, rice, sorghum and cassava to strengthen commodity markets and provide farmers with more stable market opportunities. Onion farmers, northern agriculture The statement further disclosed that the bank had introduced an Onion Financing Programme in partnership with the National Onion Producers, Processors and Marketers Association of Nigeria, which represents more than 11,800 onion farmers. The programme is designed to provide onion farmers with improved seeds and fertiliser, while supporting processors with commodity purchase financing. It will also facilitate the development of storage facilities and solar-powered cooling systems to reduce post-harvest losses. item.title: As cars go digital, US consumers pay an extra $12 billion a year for repairs
item.description: The computerization of cars comes at a price to US consumers, according to the Public Interest Research Group (PIRG), which says that software fees and other charges faced by mechanics push up garage costs. An investigation by the non-profit consumer group estimates that car repair costs for Americans have been inflated by $12 billion each year, as vehicles integrate more computerized functions. Its report, Closing Shop , is available online. To find a failed sensor, release an electronic parking brake, or perform diagnostics, a technician has to first connect a laptop or tablet to the vehicle. To so this, the repair shop has to have the right software tools, and that means paying the vehicle manufacturer subscription charges and other fees, in order to get the information they need to complete the job. If smaller independent repair shops can’t afford all the necessary software or subscriptions, they may be forced to steer customers to authorized dealerships for some fixes – about one in five jobs – and this allows the latter to charge more. PIRG claims that drivers pay for this through their insurance premiums, even if they never need to get their car fixed, because higher repair costs mean higher insurance claims. It says the price of auto insurance has risen three times as fast as the rest of the US economy since 2012. Even if mechanics do choose to pay for the software, they spend an estimated collective 83 million hours a year buying, downloading, logging in, and waiting. At typical repair rates, that adds up to $12 billion. A separate report from the PIRG Education Fund claims that a two-tiered repair model now exists, where independent sites conduct repairs with less information, less powerful diagnostic tools, and higher associated costs than the authorized dealerships. The advocacy group wants to see legislators take this issue in hand, and has a number of recommendations for them. One is to stop manufacturers from locking out independent mechanics from simple repair jobs like changing brake pads, and require them to support a standard protocol for authenticating independent diagnostic tools. Another is to give owners control over their vehicle’s data via a standardized platform for accessing telematics repair information, so that the owner can give access to an independent repair shop. Car firms can use the vehicle data to tell owners that a repair is needed and to take it to an approved repair shop, without even disclosing what the issue is. DIY repairers should be able to get everything they need to fix their own cars. Service information and basic diagnostic software should be free, and PIRG also wants a cap on the license fees manufacturers charge for their official software tools. “We’ve allowed car manufacturers to build a toll road between the mechanic and the repair,” says Nathan Proctor, leader of PIRG’s Right to Repair campaign and co-author on the report. “We have a plethora of tolls on the road – subscriptions you need for m

item.title: Crude supply to refineries hits 179.31m barrels in 10 months
item.description: By Obas Esiedesa, Abuja Crude oil supply to domestic refineries in Nigeria reached 179.31 million barrels between January and October 2026, with local production accounting for 144.97 million barrels and imports contributing 34.33 million barrels. The Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority (NMDPRA), in its October 2026 Midstream and Downstream Statistics, disclosed that crude oil supply to refineries rose to 22.8 million barrels in October, from 18.53 million barrels in September. The October figure represented a 23.1 per cent increase month-on-month. A breakdown showed that domestic crude supply increased by 19.8 per cent to 19.13 million barrels in October, from 15.97 million barrels in the preceding month. Similarly, imported crude supply rose by 43.4 per cent to 3.67 million barrels in October, compared with 2.56 million barrels in September. Meanwhile, the daily average receipt of Premium Motor Spirit (PMS), popularly known as petrol, increased by 21 per cent to 46.9 million litres per day in October, from 38.7 million litres per day in September. According to the report, domestic refineries supplied an average of 31.9 million litres of petrol daily in October, compared with 28.5 million litres per day in September, representing a 12 per cent increase. Petrol imports also increased by 47 per cent to 15 million litres per day in October, from 10.2 million litres per day in the preceding month. Despite the improvement, total petrol supply remained below the estimated daily demand benchmark of 50 million litres and the 13-month average of 50.2 million litres per day. The report further showed that domestic refineries accounted for 62.6 per cent of the 13-month average petrol supply, while imports contributed 37.4 per cent. A month-by-month breakdown indicated that domestic refinery petrol supply peaked at 41.5 million litres per day in May, while imports reached their highest level of 24.8 million litres per day in January. Combined petrol receipts peaked at 74.2 million litres per day in December 2025 before declining in subsequent months. On other petroleum products, the NMDPRA report showed that daily average receipts of Automotive Gas Oil (AGO), commonly known as diesel, increased by 93 per cent to 16.8 million litres per day in October. However, aviation fuel (ATK) receipts declined by 36 per cent to 2.1 million litres per day, while Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) receipts increased by 11 per cent to 5.2 thousand tonnes daily. The post Crude supply to refineries hits 179.31m barrels in 10 months appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: SpaceX sends classified US spy satellites to orbit in early-morning launch from California coast (video)
item.description: null SpaceX launched a batch of classified satellites this morning (Nov. 22), on the NROL-136 mission out of California. A Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Vandenberg Space Force Base's Launch Complex-4E at 7:23 a.m. ET (1223 GMT; 4:23 a.m. local time in California). It was the sixth National Reconnaissance Office launch (NROL) this year to deliver a payload, or group of payloads, to low Earth orbit , all which have been carried out by SpaceX 's workhorse Falcon 9. The launch marks another step in the NRO's effort to expand its intelligence-gathering capabilities through a proliferated network of spacecraft designed to provide more frequent and timely surveillance of locations around the globe. A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launches the NROL-136 mission for the U.S. National Reconnaissance Office from California on Nov. 22, 2026. (Image credit: SpaceX) About two minutes after liftoff, the Falcon 9's first-stage booster separated from the rocket's upper stage, which continued carrying the classified payloads onward to orbit. The booster then reversed course and returned to Vandenberg, touching down at Landing Zone 4 approximately seven and a half minutes after launch. Saturday's launch was the 14th flight for this particular Falcon 9 booster, dubbed B1097, which previously launched NASA 's Sentinel-6B ocean-monitoring satellite, NROL-172, USSF-259 for the U.S. Space Force , and eight Starlink missions. NROL-136 is the 15th launch dedicated to building the NRO's "proliferated architecture," the satellites for which have been developed in partnership with SpaceX and Northrop Grumman. The network is designed to increase coverage and improve the "capability and resilience" of U.S. intelligence operations in space , according to the NRO's mission website . The NRO began deploying the constellation in May 2024 with the launch of NROL-146. The most recent proliferated architecture mission before Sunday was NROL-179, which lifted off on June 19, 2026. As with any classified mission, the agency has not disclosed the exact number of satellites aboard NROL-136 or revealed details about their onboard technologies.

item.title: Tinubu hails ICPC boss, Aliyu on election as Chairman of African Asset Recovery Forum
item.description: ‎ ‎By Johnbosco Agbakwuru ‎ ‎ABUJA — PRESIDENT Bola Tinubu has congratulated the Chairman of the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC), Dr Musa Adamu Aliyu, SAN, on his election as substantive Chairman of the Steering Council of the African Asset Recovery Practitioners’ Forum (AARP-Forum). ‎ ‎The President described Dr Aliyu’s election at the Forum’s First General Assembly in Abuja as a significant recognition of his leadership, professional competence and commitment to strengthening Africa’s collective response to corruption, illicit financial flows and the recovery of stolen public assets. ‎ ‎President Tinubu noted that Dr Aliyu’s emergence, following his successful tenure as Interim Chairperson, reflects the confidence and trust reposed in his capacity to provide strategic direction and consolidate the institutional foundations of the continental initiative. ‎ ‎He commended the ICPC Chairman for his contributions to establishing the Forum’s institutional structures, fostering continental partnerships and advancing a coordinated framework for asset recovery across Africa. ‎ ‎He observed that the election comes at a critical time when African countries must deepen cooperation, strengthen legal and institutional frameworks, and deploy more effective mechanisms to trace, freeze, confiscate and repatriate proceeds of corruption and other illicit activities. ‎ ‎President Tinubu particularly welcomed the Forum’s adoption of its 2027–2029 Strategic Work Plan and its commitment to implementing the Common African Position on Asset Recovery (CAPAR), describing these as important steps toward translating continental commitments into practical, measurable outcomes. ‎ ‎The President stressed that recovering stolen assets must go beyond confiscation to include transparent management, repatriation, and productive utilisation for the benefit of citizens, particularly in communities and countries deprived of resources through corruption. ‎ ‎He expressed confidence that under Dr Aliyu’s substantive leadership, the Forum will strengthen collaboration among African anti-corruption institutions, prosecution authorities, financial intelligence units, and international development partners. ‎ ‎President Tinubu also commended the participating institutions and member states for the confidence they have shown in Dr Aliyu and urged them to sustain the spirit of cooperation and collective responsibility that characterised the electoral process. ‎ ‎The President wished Dr Aliyu a successful tenure and assured him of Nigeria’s continued commitment to regional and continental initiatives that promote transparency, accountability, good governance and the fight against corruption. The post Tinubu hails ICPC boss, Aliyu on election as Chairman of African Asset Recovery Forum appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Army repels bandits’ attacks in Benue, rescues two women
item.description: By Peter Duru, Makurdi Troops of the Nigerian Army have repelled attacks by suspected armed bandits on military personnel and communities in Ukum Local Government Area of Benue State, rescuing two women reportedly abducted during the incident. The attacks reportedly occurred on Friday night and Saturday morning in Mbatian community in Dyom, as well as Atuluku, Tse Kasua and Amachigh villages. A source in the area said the attackers also targeted military personnel stationed in the area but were repelled by the troops. The source disclosed that two women were abducted from Mbatian community but were subsequently rescued following the intervention of the military. “The attack occurred Friday night and Saturday morning. They also attacked military personnel at their duty posts, but luckily, the military repelled them. “The two women were kidnapped by the armed men in Mbatian community but were eventually rescued by the military, who intervened quickly to avert a major disaster in the affected communities,” the source said. Meanwhile, the Chairman of Ukum Local Government Area, Jonathan Modi, has commended the Nigerian Army for its response to the attacks and efforts to protect lives and property. Modi, in a statement by his Special Assistant on Media and Public Communications, Samuel Atsua, said the commendation followed the successful repulsion of the attack on Mbatian community in Dyom and subsequent incidents in other villages. He said the military’s prompt intervention helped prevent further casualties and destruction of property, particularly highlighting the rescue of the two abducted women. The chairman described the military’s response as a demonstration of courage, professionalism and commitment to national service. He added that the continued presence and operational activities of security personnel were important to restoring residents’ confidence and protecting vulnerable communities. Modi subsequently visited the military base in Dyom, where he met with the Commander of the newly established 11 Brigade, Gboko, Brigadier General Akinkunmi Odubiyi, and other military personnel following reports of an attack on soldiers stationed in the community. He assured the Army that the local government administration would continue to provide the necessary support and cooperation to strengthen security operations. “I assure the Nigerian Army that the Ukum Local Government administration remains committed to providing the necessary support and cooperation to strengthen security operations and ensure the protection of lives, property and territorial integrity of the area,” he said. Modi urged the military and other security agencies to sustain their operations, particularly by maintaining their presence and responding promptly to security threats in vulnerable communities.
